subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing name should OpenClaw use for the existing `google-vertex` provider after Google's Vertex AI branding change?
rationale: The stale copy is source-proven, but the issue's requested wording differs from Google's current official page title and any provider-id rename would be compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Use current Google wording
options.body: Update visible labels/docs to a maintained form such as `Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)` while preserving all `google-vertex` identifiers.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI for now
options.body: Leave current copy unchanged until Google APIs, SDK docs, and OpenClaw provider docs consistently move away from Vertex AI wording.

options.title: Use shorter enterprise wording
options.body: Adopt a shorter UI label such as `Google Enterprise AI`, but document that it maps to the existing `google-vertex` provider and Vertex/ADC setup.

recommendation.title: Use current Google wording
recommendation.body: Update visible labels/docs to a maintained form such as `Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)` while preserving all `google-vertex` identifiers.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent provider-catalog onboarding work makes this the closest visible product-copy ownership signal in current history.
